Game Overview

In Sky Collectors, the core idea is straightforward: soar through the skies in Sky Collectors, a captivating aerial adventure that tests your precision and timing. Navigate your helicopter, collect shimmering stars, and outmaneuver your friends or crafty bots in fast-paced flight escapades. Perfect for solo play or group fun—each moment is a star-studded challenge!
